name: Hadejia

routes.outcome: Official Jigawa State Ministry of Lands portal identifies registry, survey-management, and land-administration services.
Official public Search Land Records page; JavaScript configuration exposed GET https://land.jg.gov.ng/search/results with file_no, plot_no, property_unique_id, owner_name, and lga parameters.

Bounded anonymous Hadejia-LGA response returned success=true, count=100, and parcel-record rows. The endpoint response was not retained because it included unsafe owner/certificate fields alongside safe identifiers; no geometry was present.
Parcel detail HTML loaded, but inspection found no safe polygon, coordinates, viewer configuration, or geometry API reference.
No API route at this guessed path; no further guessed detail/API routes were pursued.
Official JIGAWA GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION SYSTEM document describes computerized land administration and GIS context, but supplies no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Search page JavaScript configuration observed; no map viewer or geometry-service configuration observed.
schemaAndCrs.responseSchema: Observed bounded search response: success, count, data[]. Safe-looking fields included numeric id, plot_no, property_unique_id, lga, location, landuse, and area; unsafe fields were not retained.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: The response exposed numeric id and property_unique_id, but stable identity semantics were not independently established. No synthetic identity was created.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Hadejia LGA registry search; exact WUP point [12.4544922719472,10.0390908465973] preserved for qualification but the service has no coordinate query in the observed UI.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if later qualified

qualification.reason: Local registry search is real and Hadejia-scoped, but no anonymous native geometry service, CRS, or stable parcel-identity semantics were qualified.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
Search result count 100 is endpoint-limited and is not a citywide parcel count.
The Hadejia LGA search response was bounded to IDs/geometry assessment; raw source attributes were discarded and no unsafe fields were retained.
No parcel polygon is retained because no safe native geometry response was obtained.
A missing geometry route or detail-page limitation is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate, or personal fields are retained.
uncertainty: The local Jigawa registry custodian and public search procedure are evidenced. Current geometry coverage, map/API availability, CRS, update cadence, stable identity rules, and adapter/runtime behavior remain unverified.
